chapter: Mellophone, Brunswick records and the West End Roof
title: Bienville Roof, the Slipper fire and quitting Jules Bauduc's band
summary: He explains where the Bienville and West End roofs were and how he left Bauduc's band after the Slipper fire and his stolen car.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: The building is still there. The roof is still there. It's right there at Lee Circle. You know St. Charles where the circle is there? Well it's an oil building now. That was the Biennale Hotel and the roof garden was on the top of it. And it was owned by the roof.
How helpful. Somebody told me there was a Biennale roof or something out there at the West End.

No that was the West End roof. They had one out there. West End. Yeah. Well while I was playing at the Biennale Jules Vaduc I had originally been with Jules' band you see. Yeah. And we got burnt out at the Slipper. And two weeks after that I parked in front of the Slipper. I parked in front of the Slipper. And went to the show. And they stole my automobile. While I was at the show. That was two weeks after the fire. No it never did get back. Never got to this day. So man I was all swelled up. So we were rehearsing to go to a place out on the ridge. A gambling house that the Capone's owned called the Victory Inn. And we were rehearsing to go out there. And I asked for somebody to give me some hand with the drums. To help with the drums. To get them out there you see. And nobody offered to help me. I was swelled up. I didn't want to pay no cab fare out there. So I quit. I told the doctor. I said here take you. I took the book and I threw it to them. And I quit the band. Well then. Later on. They worked out the Victory Inn. I think it only lasted about a month or so. And later on. First I went to the Biennville. Jules got me the job. I put the band in the Biennville. And he put the band out to West End Roof. That's where the Owls made their reputation. Out there at the West End Roof. That was. It was. You know where that West End Park is. Yeah I know.
Doc Sushone once had me take a picture of it. And he told me it was the Biennville Roof. No no.
I'm sure you cut the name.
